paragraphs.text: Khod is a legendary homarid warrior from Dominaria .

Khod is said to be an envoy of the Etlan Shiis merfolk colony, however, in the canon timeline , there are no Homarids in Etlan Shiis due to the merfolk there having fled from them. This along with him only appearing on a playtest card makes his existence dubious in canon. Khod acts as a lord for several underwater creatures including Homarids , Camarids , Cephalids , Nautilids , and Merfolk . He appears to wield a ship anchor.
